title: A New Capital

lesson.themeZh: 诸侯分裂、权力与百姓苦难
learningObjectivesZh: 解释十八路诸侯为何停止追击董卓
叙述董卓如何重建长安并展示其残暴
分析王允的处境和貂蝉的结尾计划

sections.title: The Alliance Falls Apart
sections.summaryZh: 刘备看到洛阳的废墟，呼吁十八路诸侯继续追击董卓。然而孙坚、袁绍等人各有顾虑，军队陆续撤走；曹操决定独自出兵，刘备认为兵力仍不足。

sections.title: The Oath Brothers Return Home
sections.summaryZh: 刘备、关羽和张飞谈论战争给普通百姓带来的苦难，批评诸侯只关心权力。由于兵力不足，他们第二天带兵返回平原县。

sections.title: Dong Zhuo's New Capital
sections.summaryZh: 董卓击败曹操后迁都长安。他用从洛阳富户掠夺的财富重建城市，并为自己建造兼具宫殿和堡垒功能的眉坞宫。

sections.title: Cruelty at Meiwo Palace
sections.titleZh: 眉坞宫宴会的残酷场面
sections.summaryZh: 王允不情愿地参加董卓的宴会，看到董卓穿着仅皇帝可穿的黄色袍服。董卓把战俘称为叛徒，在宾客面前羞辱他们，还下令不给食物和饮水。

sections.title: Diao Chan's Plan
sections.summaryZh: 宴会后王允忧心忡忡，独自在花园散步。深受王允信赖的歌女貂蝉主动上前，说自己已有除掉董卓的计划。

vocabulary.example: The warlords argued about whether to continue the campaign.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 各路诸侯对是否继续出征意见不一。

vocabulary.example: Liu Bei wondered whether the generals were loyal to the emperor.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 刘备质疑将领们是否忠于皇帝。

vocabulary.example: Cao Cao called the departing commanders cowards.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 曹操称撤离的将领为懦夫。

vocabulary.example: Liu Bei hated seeing ordinary people suffer during the war.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 刘备不愿看到百姓在战争中受苦。

vocabulary.example: The oath brothers returned to Pingyuan County together.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 结义兄弟一起返回平原县。

vocabulary.example: Dong Zhuo used stolen riches to rebuild Chang'an.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 董卓用掠夺来的财富重建长安。

vocabulary.example: Dong Zhuo built a palace that also served as a fortress.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 董卓建造的宫殿同时也是一座堡垒。

vocabulary.example: Wang Yun reluctantly attended Dong Zhuo's dinner party.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 王允不情愿地参加董卓的宴会。

vocabulary.example: Dong Zhuo called the captured soldiers traitors.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 董卓把被俘士兵称作叛徒。

vocabulary.example: Wang Yun was horrified by Dong Zhuo's cruelty.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 王允对董卓的残暴深感痛心。

vocabulary.example: Wang Yun trusted Diao Chan because she was wise and devoted.
vocabulary.exampleZh: 王允因貂蝉聪慧忠诚而信赖她。

questions.question: Why did Sun Jian decide to take his army home?

options.text: He had made a secret agreement with Dong Zhuo.
He feared another warlord might seize his land while he was away.
He had already captured Chang'an.
He had been chosen to guard the emperor.

questions.explanation: 孙坚担心自己离开领地太久，其他诸侯可能趁机占领他的土地，因此决定带兵回家。

questions.question: Why did Liu Bei decide not to follow Cao Cao's troops?

options.text: He believed that two armies were not strong enough to face Dong Zhuo.
Dong Zhuo had already surrendered to Cao Cao.
Yuan Shao ordered him to stay in Luoyang.
His brothers had decided to join Dong Zhuo.

questions.explanation: 刘备判断，即使加入曹操也只有两支军队，兵力远不足以对抗董卓，因此没有跟随曹操出征。

questions.question: How did Dong Zhuo get the money to rebuild Chang'an?

options.text: He borrowed money from Liu Bei.
The emperor gave him money as a reward.
He sold his new palace to the warlords.
He had taken the wealth of rich citizens from Luoyang.

questions.explanation: 董卓毁掉洛阳前，先搜刮当地富人的财产，再用这些掠夺来的财富修建长安和自己的宫殿。

questions.question: How did Dong Zhuo treat the prisoners at his dinner party?

options.text: He invited them to sit beside his guests.
He praised their courage and freed them.
He humiliated them and ordered them given no food or water.
He let Wang Yun decide their fate.

questions.explanation: 董卓把俘虏带到宴席上供人羞辱，随后命令将他们关回牢房，不许给食物或水，表现出他的残暴。

questions.question: What did Diao Chan tell Wang Yun in the garden?

options.text: She had a plan to get rid of Dong Zhuo.
She would lead Liu Bei's soldiers to Chang'an.
Cao Cao had already defeated Dong Zhuo.
The emperor had escaped from the palace.

questions.explanation: 貂蝉察觉王允因董卓而烦恼，主动告诉他自己已有除掉董卓的计划。故事在这里留下悬念。
